Clean, welcoming, friendly, and knowledgeable about all things dental related. Walked in without appointment but was able to help and took care of me for cleaning and filing. All done within 1 hour.

Highly recommended!!!

I am extremely positive impressed of the professional work of the dentists there. They all speak English and they explain everything in detail to you. I did a bleaching and the result was amazing! I honestly can recommend this place to everybody!

The dentist here is very meticulous and gentle. The prices are also relatively cheaper than other places. The facility and equipment are very clean. Initially, I came in to consult the dentist about dental implants (which I had already consulted with another clinic about and decided to have done elsewhere). After talking to the dentist here, I felt more confident than at my usual clinic. After the consultation, I decided to have everything done here: teeth cleaning, whitening, tooth extraction, root canal treatment, and crowns. I'll save the implants for my next trip back to Thailand because I didn't have enough time. I have to thank the dentist here for paying attention to every detail. I am very satisfied with the treatment results. ❤️

The place is clean and the equipment is ready.
However, the staff are unhelpful.
The orthodontic brackets come off very easily and frequently. When they do come off, it costs another 500 baht to get them reattached.
The retainers also have problems fitting properly.
Overall, this place is terrible.
